title: Define group log entry and log head types in usenet-ipfs-core
description:
Define LogEntry (hlc_timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature, parent_cids: Vec<Cid>), LogHead (group_name, tip_cid, entry_count), and GroupName (validated string type). Artifact: src/group_log/types.rs in usenet-ipfs-core.

Acceptance:
- All types compile with no warnings
- GroupName validates RFC 3977 group name format on construction (returns error on invalid)
- LogEntry's parent_cids allows DAG branching (Vec, not Option<single>)
- Serialize/Deserialize derived or implemented
